title: ParadevAI/Paradev: several coding agents, on the subscriptions you already pay
friendlyTitle: ParadevAI/Paradev: run several coding agents on the plans you already pay for
summary: Paradev is on today's GitHub trending list for TypeScript. The project describes itself as an open-source alternative to the Codex app and to Conductor, for running many coding agents in parallel on subscriptions you already have. It is MIT-licensed, has about 16,000 stars, and was updated on 6 November. It sits below Meta's Astryx on the TypeScript list, and above a field of general web frameworks. Astryx is a design system that calls itself agent-ready. Paradev is the coding-agent desk.

whyItMatters: If you already pay for Codex, Claude Code, or a similar agent, Paradev is a local way to run several of them at once without a new hosted orchestrator. Conductor's cloud product was reported this week as going read-only on 13 November. This repo does not replace that product's history. It is a desk for the agents your current subscriptions already unlock. The parallel run still spends those subscriptions.
